messages:
anne-docs: Hey folks — opening PR #482 for the Python SDK migration doc (docs/sdk/python/migration.md). CI preview passed but there's a layout overflow on the code examples and a couple of terminology nits (we renamed param `model_id` -> `model` in the SDK). Need reviewers for: examples/screenshots (mike-ux), SDK snippet correctness + migration notes (sam-devex), API naming/deprecation guidance (lee-engineering), and a quick legal check for any data-handling wording (nora-legal). Hoping to merge before Monday. PTAL.

ci-bot: Docs preview build succeeded: https://deploy.preview/redwood/pr/482 — artifacts at /pr-482/index.html :white_check_mark:

mike-ux: I can review examples/screens. ETA EOD today. I saw the overflow on mobile; likely a CSS pre block width issue.

sam-devex: I will update the Python snippet to match SDK v0.9 pattern — want async + sync small examples. Also will add a short migration snippet showing `model_id -> model`. Any preferences on snippet length?

anne-docs: Short is better, 2–3 lines for the quickstart, then one expanded example for async. Use the new variable name `model`. Example to use as canonical:

```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.text.generate(model="redwood-alpha", input="Hello")
print(resp.output_text)
```

lee-engineering: Quick flag: renaming `model_id` to `model` is a public API/SDK surface change. We should include a deprecation note and a tiny migration guide. Also add a compat example for folks still on older SDKs. Don't make the change silently.

anne-docs: Good call. I added a "Migration" section with a deprecation callout. Will we provide an automated snippet for repo-wide updates?

sam-devex: Yep — I'll add a small grep/sed helper in the migration section:

```bash
# quick repo update (verify before committing)
rg -l "model_id" docs/ | xargs sed -i 's/model_id/model/g'
```

nora-legal: One quick check from policy: examples must not include real API keys or imply sending PII. Add an explicit "Do not paste production keys" note and a short blurb about logging request data.

anne-docs: Added a short "Security note" block near the top: "Never paste real API keys in examples. Sanitize logs and avoid sharing request payloads containing user data."

mike-ux: Style guide stuff: prefer direct second-person voice ("you"), sentence case for headings, and inline code for endpoint names. Also trim long screenshots/captions. I'll send inline comments in the PR for each change. :eyes:

anne-docs: Thanks — applied the voice/heading changes you suggested and shortened captions.

ci-bot: Link checker: 1 broken link found -> /old-sdk/usage (reported as ticket #345). Full check log: https://deploy.preview/redwood/pr/482/checks/link-checker.log :x:

anne-docs: I'll fix that link now — it was an old redirect we missed.

sam-devex: For approvals: I think 2 approvals + green docs preview is fine. Recommend waiting ~24h after reviewers' comments for community feedback before merging.

lee-engineering: Agree on 2 approvals and migration note. Also add a short changelog entry so platform teams see the param rename.

anne-docs: Plan: fix broken link, push the updated snippet + deprecation callout, then merge tomorrow 10:00 PDT if no objections. Tagging @eng-oncall (FYI).

ci-bot: Final status: preview rebuilt after changes — all checks passed except flaky image-snap (non-blocking). Preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood/pr/482 — ready for merge. :white_check_mark:

mike-ux: I approved with comments.

sam-devex: Approved (added the small compat snippet and the grep helper).

nora-legal: Quick ack from legal on the security blurb.

anne-docs: Thanks everyone — merging tomorrow unless something else pops up. If you want me to hold the merge for more time, say so now.

lee-engineering: No hold from me.

(moderation) ci-bot: thread closed automatically after merge window started.
